title: 1.2 Billion People Use AI Every Week. Almost None Own It.
scaffold_note: Decision scaffold for the FROM-SCRATCH rebuild of soa-01, opened 2026-10-26 (JOB REBUILD-SOA01-1) under the owner's rebuild order of the same day. Phase 2 (2026-10-26) decides the architecture: role, story structure, hook form, style direction, delivery structure, end referral and scene form. Nothing here is copied as settled from the first draft (branch video/soa-01); where a value agrees with the first draft's record, the rationale says why it survives re-derivation. PHASE 8 (2026-10-26, JOB REBUILD-SOA01-CAUSAL): the owner ruled the P1–P7 build's decisions ran backwards (video → context) and ordered a causal redo. P1 was pressure-tested (record: transcript/consolidation-causal.md §1 carries the full test in the transcript phase; the verdict is summarised in the objective/message records below). P2–P7 stand SUPERSEDED-BY-CAUSAL-REDO on this branch — their files remain in the history as the record of the backwards build, and phases 8–15 replace their substance in order. PHASE 9 (2026-10-26): architecture prescribed from the phase-8 objective — role, story structure, hook form, delivery structure, end referral and scene form re-decided as prescription, superseding the phase-2 values (which described the first draft's shipped build: its story_structure enumerated the old lines, its delivery_structure the old windows, its end_referral the old card). PHASE 10 (2026-10-26): style decided from the 14-style menu + the objective, superseding the phase-2 value (which was read off the first draft's delivered build — its rationale's own tell: 'The delivered first-draft build embodies exactly this mix').

objective.value: Make every AI user in the 1.2 billion see a renter in the mirror — and ask who owns their layer.
objective.rationale: RE-DERIVED under the causal rule (phase 8), replacing the P1 value ('Show 1.2 billion weekly users rent AI access while owning none of the layer around it'). The pressure test (source / constraint / substance): the P1 value's SUBSTANCE passed — the fact is the lane's founding sourced fact (OpenAI DevDay, 2026-09-29: 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users) and the rent/own read is canon §4's ownership thesis applied to it. Its FORM failed both other tests: its recorded derivation opened the first draft's script doc and ratified its statement (source test), and 'Show X rents Y' is satisfied by any accurate third-person explainer — including one the viewer files as news about other people — while the funnel purpose (this report feeds 'Who Owns the Toaster?') requires the viewer to locate THEMSELVES in the number and leave carrying the ownership question (constraint test). The re-derived value is stated as the viewer change: mirror first ('see a renter in the mirror'), then the carried question ('ask who owns their layer'). 20 words.
objective.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 8, 2026-10-26) — derived from the lane's purpose (State of Adoption: one dated, sourced fact read against the ownership prescription) + the funnel role (bridge to 'Who Owns the Toaster?') + canon.md §4
objective.record: files/canon.md §4 (the ownership thesis) + phase-8 pressure test, summarised here and carried in full at transcript/consolidation-causal.md §1

message.value: You use it every week. You own none of it. (Viewer restatement: 'Over a billion people now use AI every week — and everything they build up inside it, their instructions, their memory, their files, lives in a layer they rent.')
message.rationale: RE-DERIVED from the re-derived objective (phase 8), replacing the P1 value. P1 defined the message AS the first draft's closing line ('Adoption is total. Ownership is zero.') — the artifact's payoff defining the message is the reverse direction, whatever the line's quality. Derived forward: the objective needs the viewer to hold two things in one breath, addressed to themselves — the habit (use, every week) and the absence (own, none of it). The scale pole of the old pair is not lost: it is carried by the hook and the objective, where the objective puts it. The essence is therefore the use/own pair in the second person.
message.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 8, 2026-10-26), from the phase-8 objective

audience.value: The renters themselves: people who use AI every week through a chat box they do not own — the very users the 1.2B statistic counts. Secondarily, the AI-curious public who read adoption numbers as good news and have never asked who owns the layer. The misconception the piece corrects: 'I use ChatGPT every week, so the AI setup is mine — my instructions, my memory, my files belong to me.' In fact all of it lives on the provider's terms and vanishes when the tab closes.
audience.rationale: STANDS, derivation upgraded (phase 8). P1 inferred this audience from the first draft's evidence (its bridge card's second person, its L5 intent note, the lane pattern, the funnel design). Under the phase-8 objective the inference is no longer load-bearing: the objective ('make every AI user in the 1.2 billion see a renter in the mirror') only operates addressed to a counted user, so this audience is REQUIRED by the prescription, not merely evidenced by the artifact. Value unchanged; the four artifact-side exhibits are retired to corroboration. Confidence stays reasoning-grade (register R-4).
audience.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 8, 2026-10-26) — required by the phase-8 objective; P1's evidence list retained as corroboration in the phase-1 record
audience.record: files/short-soa01-billion-script.md (L5 intent; bridge card text) + files/short-soa02-half-america-phase0.md (lane audience pattern) + first-draft metadata.json fields.audience (the OPEN this decision removes)

role.value: APPLY, as a mirror: the Academy ownership doctrine applied to one dated fact, aimed at the viewer the fact counts. The piece reports and converts; it does not INTRODUCE the doctrine (that is the Toaster long-form's and Lesson 1's work).
role.rationale: Kept from phase 2 in substance — the lane's division of labour is a fact about the funnel, not about the old build: a ~40-second report may presume the doctrine exists and spend its seconds applying it. The phase-8 objective adds the aim: APPLY addressed to the counted user (the mirror), which the phase-2 value left implicit. Recorded as re-derived, not inherited: the role follows from the funnel (the bridge hands the viewer to the INTRODUCE piece) and from the objective, in that order.
role.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 9, 2026-10-26), from the phase-8 objective + the funnel structure

story_structure.value: Six moves, prescribed from the objective: M1 THE NUMBER AS MIRROR — the sourced fact stated, then turned onto the viewer ('You are one of them'); M2 THE INVENTORY OF THE RENT — what weekly use accumulates, named concretely (instructions, memory, files — examples of 'everything you build there', never a closed anatomy count); M3 THE VANISHING TEST — the proof mechanism: if the account closed tonight, what remains yours? (a designed silence, then the answer); M4 THE LAYER NAMED — two parts in plain words: the model supplies the intelligence; everything that makes it yours lives in the layer around it, and the layer is the part that can be owned; M5 THE ALTERNATIVE, ONE BEAT — that layer can live as files on your own machine, then it is yours; M6 PAYOFF + BRIDGE — the essence stated once, then the referral hands the carried question to the long-form. The question the video answers (viewer-voiced): 'I use AI every week — what do I actually own?'
story_structure.rationale: Each move exists because the objective requires it, in this order: self-location before argument (M1 — a number about other people persuades nobody); the rent made concrete before it is judged (M2); the rent FELT before it is named (M3 — 'rented' asserted is a slogan, demonstrated by the vanishing test it is a feeling, and the objective needs the feeling); the doctrine named only after the viewer has something to attach it to (M4); the alternative rationed to one beat because this piece reports and converts — the long-form teaches the how (M5); the essence spoken once, at the end, where the mirror has been built (M6). No dateline beat: the lane's dated-fact law is served by the on-screen source line, and narration's first seconds belong to the mirror, not to a label.
story_structure.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 9, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-8 objective
story_structure.record: phase-8 objective (this file); embodied in transcript/transcript.md (phase 11) and scene/scene.json (phase 12)

hook_form.value: Sourced statistic + second-person capture inside the first line pair: the number lands first as a monumental visual (cinematic type, phase 10) with its source on screen (OpenAI DevDay · Sep 29, 2026), and the narration's second line turns it onto the viewer. Fact-then-mirror; no spoken dateline.
hook_form.rationale: The objective requires self-location before argument, so the hook is a two-step: the fact supplies the scale a cold viewer cannot scroll past, the mirror line converts scale into self-recognition while the number is still on screen. The phase-2 form (the number as hook, arriving after a spoken dateline) spent the first 2.66 s on a label; the prescription spends them on the number itself. The source rides the number visually — the lane's credibility law — instead of being spoken.
hook_form.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 9, 2026-10-26), from the phase-8 objective + the lane's dated-fact law
hook_form.record: phase-8 objective (this file); scene/scene.json compartment C1–C2 (phase 12)

style_direction.value: CINEMATIC TYPOGRAPHY for the number (M1) and the payoff (M6) — type at monumental scale, held frames — + MOTION GRAPHICS (A59 grammar) for everything between: independent cutout objects on a dark void, one focal group at a time, principal-word entry grammar (rise 24 units, scale 0.82→1, 0.28 s, cubic ease-out), semantic continuity as the scene's law (the inventory objects are rented, vanish, reappear inside the layer ring, and land as files). Both styles are in the owner's starting set (#77).
style_direction.rationale: Derived from the four jobs the objective assigns style: (a) the number must feel monumental — cinematic type is the menu's instrument for scale, and the hook's first step is the number's weight; (b) the vanishing test (M3) is an OBJECT event — rented things must visibly leave, which type alone cannot perform, so the middle of the piece is motion graphics with persistent objects; (c) the layer must read as ONE thing that can change owner — a single ring object whose contents transfer (C5→C6); (d) a dated-fact report must keep its authority — the dark void and held frames keep the register; whiteboard's classroom sketch and collage's texture noise were rejected on this point, and 2D graphics as the named spine was rejected because it undersells the type monument (the objects are flat cutouts, but the work they do — persistence, role change, transfer — is motion-graphics work). DIVERGES from phase 2 (motion graphics + 2D, cinematic typography not adopted because it 'cannot draw the mechanism'): that reasoning assigned type the mechanism's job; this derivation assigns type only the two jobs it can do — the number and the payoff — and gives the mechanism to objects. The exp-02 cinematic specimen is evidence that type can monumentalize this piece's number; it is cited as evidence, not adopted as the decision's source, and the SOA lane's direction stays open for the owner's verdict (#79, register R-1) — this is soa-01's own style decision.
style_direction.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 10, 2026-10-26), from the phase-8 objective + files/a59-motion-brief.md (the 14-style menu, #77 starting set, A59 grammar)
style_direction.record: files/a59-motion-brief.md — STYLE MENU RULING (#77) + transferable grammar; first-draft package experiments/exp-02 (specimen cited as evidence only)

delivery_structure.value: Report cadence over the six moves, with TWO designed silences: statement / turn (M1) → inventory (M2) → test setup (M3) → DESIGNED SILENCE (the viewer answers the test first) → the answer → naming (M4) → one-beat alternative (M5) → PRE-PAYOFF SILENCE → payoff (M6) → bridge under bed only. Inter-line gaps are functional, sized at the transcript phase and embodied as the measured pause map in transcript/delivery.md (phase 11): gaps 0.35–0.80 s by joint function; the two designed silences 1.00 s each; lead-in 1.20 s while the number monument assembles; tail 2.40 s holding the payoff and the bridge card.
delivery_structure.rationale: Supersedes the phase-2 value (contiguous windows, no built-in silence, one silence after the close) — that pattern described the first draft's delivered windows. The prescription derives the pattern from the moves instead: the test (M3) only works if the viewer is given a beat to answer it themselves, and the payoff (M6) only lands as a verdict if it is not crowded by the alternative beat. Everything else stays tight — a wire-report register does not breathe between facts.
delivery_structure.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 9, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-9 story structure
delivery_structure.record: transcript/delivery.md (phase 11 — the pause map) + transcript/transcript.md (the settled starts)

end_referral.value: Bridge card in the final seconds, over the held payoff: headline 'WHO OWNS YOUR LAYER?' — the question the viewer now carries, restated — with 'The long answer: Who Owns the Toaster? →' beneath it. Target: the funnel long-form 'Who Owns the Toaster?' (fg2cV8sh3kY), flagship channel. Silent (bed only); navigation load = the card's ~2.4 s tail ≈ 6% of the piece, inside the ≤10% budget.
end_referral.rationale: The card's wording is derived from the objective, not inherited: the bridge's job is to hand over the QUESTION the piece was built to install ('ask who owns their layer'), so the question is the headline and the long-form is named as its answer. The phase-2 card ('Renters can become owners.') is a slogan in the renter's terms — good copy, but it answers a question the old structure never made the viewer ask; this structure spends six moves making the viewer ask it, and the card names it. Silent and bed-only so the payoff is not talked over.
end_referral.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 9, 2026-10-26), from the phase-8 objective + the funnel design
end_referral.record: files/canon.md §4 + phase-8 objective (this file); scene/scene.json compartment C8 (phase 12)

scene_decomposition.value: ONE self-contained HTML file (the MP4 renders from this file alone), decomposed into eight compartments with one home each, following the six moves one-for-one: C1 number monument (M1) · C2 mirror line (M1) · C3 inventory objects — the accumulated things as separate cutout objects (M2) · C4 the vanishing stage — C3's objects exit (M3) · C5 the layer ring — model core + surrounding layer, C3's objects reappearing inside it (M4) · C6 files on a machine — the layer's contents landing as files (M5) · C7 payoff type (M6) · C8 bridge card (M6). Plus the standing compartments: the word-animation layer (the narration's words as objects in the picture), the audio compartment, and the in-page decision-record layer. SEMANTIC CONTINUITY IS THE SCENE'S LAW: the same objects are rented (C3), lost (C4), named as the layer's contents (C5) and owned (C6) — no fresh decoration per beat.
scene_decomposition.rationale: The inventory is prescribed from the architecture (phase 9), not enumerated from a shipped file: each compartment exists because a move requires a visual event, and the continuity law exists because the objective's argument is about the SAME things changing owner — if the objects were re-drawn per beat, the argument would be illustrated instead of performed. One focal group at a time (phase-10 style). Embodied element-by-element in phase 12 (scene/scene.json).
scene_decomposition.source: archer reasoning (this branch, phase 9, 2026-10-26), derived from the phase-9 story structure
